setup:
In MetaTrader 5:
1. Tools > Options > Expert Advisors: tick "Allow algorithmic trading" and "Allow WebRequest for listed URL", and add http://127.0.0.1 to the list.
2. Navigator > Expert Advisors: drag OpenTraderBridge onto any one chart and tick "Allow Algo Trading". Refresh the Navigator if it is not listed.
The plugin connects within a few seconds. Leave that chart open while you use OpenTrader.
